import React from 'react' import { Link } from 'react-router-dom' import { Card, CardBody } from "reactstrap" import caculateAvgRating from '../utils/avgRating' import "./TourCard.css" const TourCard = ({ tour }) => { const { _id, title, city, photo, price, featured, reviews } = tour const {totalRating, avgRating} = caculateAvgRating(reviews) return (
{featured && Tour nổi bật}
{city} {avgRating === 0 ? null : avgRating} {totalRating === 0 ? ( "Chưa có đánh giá" ) : ( ({reviews.length}) )}
{title}
{Number(price).toLocaleString('vi-VN')}đ /1 người/
) } export default TourCard
